candidates.change_summary: Change owned() to set owner to a fixed hardcoded address (0x000...001) instead of msg.sender, so owner differs after call.
Change owned() to set owner to tx.origin instead of msg.sender, so owner can differ for some call contexts.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), so owned() can be called by non-owner and set owner to msg.sender, changing resulting owner.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender == tx.origin instead of msg.sender == owner, so externally-called owned() by contracts may succeed differently and change owner.

Replace the require that checks owner's balance with a no-op (removed), allowing burn to succeed without reducing totalSupply if balance insufficient would have blocked it (changing observable totalSupply after burn calls).
Subtract from totalSupply before subtracting owner's balance, potentially allowing underflow behavior on balance (but totalSupply changes immediately and differs from original ordering).
Make burn callable by anyone by removing the onlyOwner modifier invocation (changes who can reduce totalSupply).

Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the guard so only non-owners can execute owner-restricted functions; this affects burn because onlyOwner now blocks owner but allows others to call burn altering totalSupply from different callers.
